concepts.title: Credit and Micro Finance in Rural Areas

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Credit and Micro Finance in Rural Areas' refers to.
questions.a: Rural development requires an adequate credit system because farmers need money for inputs before harvest; sources range from moneylenders and traders in the informal sector to banks and cooperatives in the formal sector, and self help groups with bank linkage provide micro credit to the rural poor, especially women.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Credit and Micro Finance in Rural Areas'.
questions.a: Self help groups pool small savings, lend among members and then borrow from banks, giving the poor credit without collateral.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Credit and Micro Finance in Rural Areas' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: Rural credit (source: keec105.txt credit and micro finance sections)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Agricultural Market System and Diversification' refers to.
questions.a: The agricultural market system requires regulated markets, minimum support price, buffer stocks and public distribution system to protect farmers and consumers, while agricultural diversification into allied activities of livestock, fisheries, horticulture and organic farming raises rural incomes and sustainability.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Agricultural Market System and Diversification'.
questions.a: Diversification spreads risk beyond crop failures and adds value through allied activities like dairy, poultry and fish production.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Agricultural Market System and Diversification' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: Agricultural market system (source: keec105.txt market system and diversification sections)

concepts.title: Organic Farming, Sustainable Development and Rural Employment

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Organic Farming, Sustainable Development and Rural Employment' refers to.
questions.a: Organic farming uses organic manure and biopesticides instead of chemical inputs, offering sustainable incomes, healthier food and export prospects though with lower yields initially, while rural employment programmes like MGNREGA provide wage employment and food security to the rural poor.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Organic Farming, Sustainable Development and Rural Employment'.
questions.a: Organic farming promotes sustainable development by protecting soil fertility and avoiding chemical pollution.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Organic Farming, Sustainable Development and Rural Employment' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: Organic farming and employment (source: keec105.txt organic farming and employment sections)
